messages:
megan: Postmortem follow-up: we identified 6 remediation bullets for DR/regional failover but didn't assign a single tracking epic. Can we lock owners and propose firm ETAs?

priya: I'll own cross-region backup verification and the restore checklist consolidation. Need to confirm retention windows with infra. ETA: 2026-04-01 for doc + checks.

daniel: I'll take the routing policy refactor (ensure weighted routes and auto-fallback). Plan: PR with policy schema + unit tests by 2026-03-26.

marco: I'll pair with daniel on the traffic shaping playbook and implement the 5/25/100 canary. Also will add latency thresholds and Prometheus alerts. ETA 2026-03-27.

megan: priya - put the exact snapshot validation commands into the runbook under a new "restore-preflight" section so we can wire CI checks later.

priya: Will add. Draft snippets:```bash
# list latest snapshots
gcloud compute snapshots list --filter="labels=redwood-prod" --sort-by=~creationTimestamp | head -n 3
# check snapshot region label
gcloud compute snapshots describe SNAP_ID --format="value(labels.region)"
```

sylvia: I'll own the restore runbook steps for spinning warm-standby and KV priming. Adding an automated smoke-test after cache prime. ETA 2026-04-02.

alex: I'll prepare the chaos script for game-day (network partition + control-plane delay) and run a dry-run with SRE. Dry-run ETA 2026-04-03.

mei: Proposed game-day: Thu 2026-04-07 09:00 PT (3h). I'll create the staffing rota. Please mark availability by 2026-03-28.

ops-bot: Note: create a single epic for tracking and auto-assign daily reminders until all linked tasks are in progress.

megan: Good. New ACTION summary below - please ack and we'll make JIRA tasks.

priya: ACTION: priya - compile cross-region backup checks, add preflight commands to runbook, doc by 2026-04-01.

daniel: ACTION: daniel - routing policy refactor + canary automation, PR by 2026-03-26.

marco: ACTION: marco - traffic-shaping playbook + alerting, PR by 2026-03-27.

sylvia: ACTION: sylvia - restore runbook KV priming + smoke test, PR by 2026-04-02.

alex: ACTION: alex - chaos script + dry-run checklist, ready by 2026-04-03.

megan: Extra: SRE noted DNS TTLs caused ~2m lag in last failover. Need temp TTL automation during the game-day.

marco: ACTION: marco + daniel - plan TTL change automation (30s during game-day, revert afterwards), ready by 2026-04-05.

priya: I'll create the tracking epic EPIC-5489 and link the tasks. Posting ticket once created.

jira-bot: EPIC-5489 created and linked: TASK-1201 (backups), TASK-1202 (routing), TASK-1203 (traffic), TASK-1204 (restore-runbook), TASK-1205 (chaos). Owners assigned per thread.

megan: Couple of notes for owners: 1) include rollback steps for all changes, 2) add a validation checklist that any oncall can run under 15m, 3) mark any config that needs infra approval early.

daniel: Will include rollback and a smoke validation script. Example check for canary health:```bash
curl -sS http://canary.example/health | jq .latency
# fail if > 200
```

priya: Added requirement: snapshot integrity CRC check during preflight. Will include commands and expected outputs.

megan: Thanks. I'll convert this thread into the handoff doc for ops and ping owners in the DR channel. Keep EPIC-5489 updated. If blockers surface, drop them here.

ops-bot: Daily reminder will ping owners until TASKs are moved to "in progress" or resolved.

megan: Thanks team, closing thread for tracking.
